Method of Attack: Hackers send emails to victims' customers, pressuring victims to pay ransom by threatening exposure of private information.
Impacted Systems: Victims' systems containing sensitive customer data

Method of Attack: Abuses the DiskCryptor open-source tool to encrypt entire drives.
Targets Windows machines through phishing and exploit kits, supplemented with worm capabilities propagating through SMB password brute-forcing.
Implements exfiltration capabilities and surveillance features, including recording audio and phone calls and taking pictures, posing as 'System Update'.
